name: Andini
declaringWar: You leave us no choice. War it must be.
attacked: We will mobilize every means of resistance to stop this transgression against our people!
defeated: We were too weak to protect ourselves...

name: Ashua
declaringWar: You leave us no choice. War it must be.
attacked: If you need your nose bloodied, we'll happily serve.
defeated: I have failed. May you, at least, know compassion towards our people.

civilopediaText.text: Ashua was a short-lived state on Sumba Island, once under the rule of Shinso before rising to independence. Led by Jin, the state ultimately fell when it was attacked by Tianwu.

name: Bree
declaringWar: You leave us no choice. War it must be.
attacked: As we can reach no peaceful resolution with you, Bree must turn, with reluctance, to war.
defeated: This isn't how it is supposed to be!

civilopediaText.text: Bree is a halfling town located east of Lake Tandano. As a herding community, it is known for producing meat of exceptional quality and rich, nourishing milk, making it a favored resting point for travelers.

name: Irgask
declaringWar: You leave us no choice. War it must be.
attacked: If you need your nose bloodied, we'll happily serve.
defeated: We... defeated? No... we had so much work to do!

civilopediaText.text: The Irigaski goblins are the native dwellers of the Tatapui Hills,  having lived in the region since the Time of Beginnings.They share amicable ties with the gnomes of Vedic, trading fruits and monster meat in exchange for shiny pebbles.

name: Khemul
declaringWar: You leave us no choice. War it must be.
attacked: We will mobilize every means of resistance to stop this transgression against our people!
defeated: What a fine battle! Khemul is willing to serve you!

civilopediaText.text: Following the fall of Suryavansha, Khemul was established in Tonra by Suryavansha exiles. Over time, Khemul had grown into a flourishing city with an economy primarily based on plantation exports.

name: Panema
declaringWar: You leave us no choice. War it must be.
attacked: You will see you have just bitten off more than you can chew.
defeated: They will write songs of this.... pray that they shall be in your favor.

civilopediaText.text: Panema was a colony of 'Nkuhanea, founded by refugees fleeing the invading Suryavansha foces. In their new refuge, they established the Panema kingdom that endured for decades before ultimately falling to an assault by Marunesia.

name: Tonthon
declaringWar: You leave us no choice. War it must be.
attacked: You will see you have just bitten off more than you can chew.
defeated: The dark guerilla will never stop haunting you!

name: Artiza
declaringWar: You shall stain this land no longer with your vileness! To arms, my countrymen - we ride to war!
attacked: You can see how fruitless this will be for you... right?
defeated: Perhaps now we will find peace in death...

civilopediaText.text: Artiza, located on Stackars, was not only one of the earliest human realms in the region, but also the first one to fall. According to the Windari, Artiza collapsed due to a great famine and was later succeeded by Louvargia.

name: Landoruel
declaringWar: You shall stain this land no longer with your vileness! To arms, my countrymen - we ride to war!
attacked: We are no strangers to war. You have strayed from the right path, and now we will correct it.
defeated: The day of judgement has come to us. But rest assured, the same will go for you!

name: Manthrill
declaringWar: Hear me, imprudent foreigner! Yurrgin declares your lands his own! Your puny colonies shall fall!
attacked: If you were wiser, you would've chosen a way of peace.
defeated: You fiend! History shall remember this!

civilopediaText.text: Manthrill was a dwarven kingdom located south of Thallin,a position that often led to rivalry between the two. Though its people shared traits with the Asili Dwarves, they claimed descent from the Gaarili line. Manthrill ultimately fell after continuously being attacked by Thallin.

name: Pid
declaringWar: You shall stain this land no longer with your vileness! To arms, my countrymen - we ride to war!
attacked: You can see how fruitless this will be for you... right?
defeated: The principles for which we have fought will survive longer than any nation you could ever build.

civilopediaText.text: The Pidians are the last group of demons spared from banishment to the Netherworld. As a reward for aiding the Elves during the Age of Demons, the gods granted them freedom to settle anywhere on Earth, yet they chose to isolate themselves on Kaitetu Island.

name: Sherehe
declaringWar: You shall stain this land no longer with your vileness! To arms, my countrymen - we ride to war!
attacked: Oh, truly you are as cruel as your nicknaame.
defeated: I regret not defending my country to the last, although it was not of use.

civilopediaText.text: Lying on the northwestern coast of Buantan Sea, Sherehe is famed for its cultural practices and the beauty of its inhabitants. It grew from a minor settlement into a thriving city-state, attracting visitors and traders from the surrounding area.

name: Silvermane
declaringWar: You shall stain this land no longer with your vileness! To arms, my countrymen - we ride to war!
attacked: We are no strangers to war. You have strayed from the right path, and now we will correct it.
defeated: How barbaric. Those who live by the sword shall perish by the sword.

civilopediaText.text: According to legend, Silvermane was founded by twin nine-tailed foxes who persuaded Jag'ar to spare the remnants of Thallin and volunteered to oversee their resettlement in the Sava Desert. After years of watching over them, the twins chose to settle, founding Silvermane—the first free city open to all races.

name: Windemer
declaringWar: You shall stain this land no longer with your vileness! To arms, my countrymen - we ride to war!
attacked: Oh, truly you are as cruel as your nicknaame.
defeated: And so the flower of Windemer falls to barbaric hands...

civilopediaText.text: The Windari are high elves of Balvaria, founders of Windemer that predates Aeltherion. They maintain good relations with the human kingdom of Louvargia and taught them the Huz'ie script, as well as the early teachings of religion and worship.

name: Canthyria
declaringWar: I have to do this, for the sake of progress if nothing else. You must be opposed!
attacked: A barbarian like you will never enough with just a horse. I am not a horse!
defeated: I don't like you, not from the beginning.

civilopediaText.text: Canthyria lies within the Central Plains, between the Central Lake and Rain Forest. Its people, the Cantirii are divided nto two groups -one group remains in their homeland, while the other joined Niranna following the marriage between Thanue and Araros, son of Arathoros.

name: Velkan
declaringWar: I have to do this, for the sake of progress if nothing else. You must be opposed!
attacked: Very well, this shall not be forgotten.
defeated: Unacceptable!

civilopediaText.text: Velkan is a coastal state of Nabui, known for its good relations with Twin Mountain to the west. Like the people of Panema, the Velkaan are of Nkuhanean origin, with ancestors believed to have come from the historical region of Aaru.

name: Dayne
declaringWar: I have to do this, for the sake of progress if nothing else. You must be opposed!
attacked: Just because you can't pay me, you declare war on me?
defeated: Just take all my slave, will you?

civilopediaText.text: Dayne was an old city located on the coast of Laban. Originally a fishing and trade center, its influence waned with the rise of its own colony, Shaquad, which grew into a formidable rival. Dayne fell after being attacked by Torakj.

name: Dunfirr
declaringWar: I have to do this, for the sake of progress if nothing else. You must be opposed!
attacked: Very well, this shall not be forgotten.
defeated: The great things we'll about to create are gone.

civilopediaText.text: Dunfirr was a group of dwarves who inhabited the Khorin Mountains. It was incorporated into the Kingdom of Cremona after the marriage of the Tilteinen Prince Balin and the Dunfiri Princess Disa.

name: Kov
declaringWar: I have to do this, for the sake of progress if nothing else. You must be opposed!
attacked: Very well, this shall not be forgotten.
defeated: So what is the meaning of a miner?

civilopediaText.text: Found in the southeasternmost of the Merair Mountain Range, the kobolds are adapting to cold and harsh environments, although they prefer warm, damp, and subterranean habitats. The Kovs survival in harsh climates is largely due to their tenacity, rapid reproduction, and ingenuity.

name: Rog
declaringWar: Hungry ... hungry for eternity ...
attacked: What a coincidence, I yearns for a fresh flesh myself!
defeated: Least spare me your leftover meat.

civilopediaText.text: Rog was an ogre tribal state famed for its brawn rather than its intelligence. During  the First Eustasian Crisis, Rog was subjugated by Saeth of Tugu and later marched as part of Saeth's forces in the conquest of the Thorin Empire.

name: Clockwerk
declaringWar: In responding to your unstinting malignancy, we can have no recourse but war!
attacked: The law of cause and effect. Your ignorance will be your fall.
defeated: Today, the Clockwerks obey you, but do not think this is over...

civilopediaText.text: Lying along the banks of the Vambit River, Clockwerk was a civilization renowned for its nechanical ingenuity. Named by later scholars, Clockwerk people are believed to be the original creators of windmill.

name: Angasin
declaringWar: You have revealed your purposes a bit too early, my friend...
attacked: Traitorous man! I will not stand for such wanton abuse and slander - I shall have your head!
defeated: Perhaps, in another world, we could have been friends...

civilopediaText.text: Angasin is the only known settlement of Gnomes in Kilendia and, alongside Vedic, one of the last surviving gnome civilizations to endure into the present age.

name: Concordia
declaringWar: You have revealed your purposes a bit too early, my friend...
attacked: Traitorous man! I will not stand for such wanton abuse and slander - I shall have your head!
defeated: A wrong calculation, on my part.

name: Crotoa
declaringWar: You have revealed your purposes a bit too early, my friend...
attacked: Traitorous man! I will not stand for such wanton abuse and slander - I shall have your head!
defeated: We never fully trusted you from the start.

civilopediaText.text: Crotoan are among the native beastfolk of the East, living on the Selasia Island. Through covert trading networks, they aided many beastfolk enslaved by Thallin in escaping westward. Following Thallin’s fall, Crotoa assisted Jag'ar and his fellow beastfolk in traveling to and establishing the city of Townfolk.

name: Frostwaste
declaringWar: You have revealed your purposes a bit too early, my friend...
attacked: Traitorous man! I will not stand for such wanton abuse and slander - I shall have your head!
defeated: May the Heavens forgive you for inflicting this humiliation to our people.
uniques: [+2 Food] from every [Snow]

civilopediaText.text: Frostwaste was an old, perhaps the oldest, known settlement on Kuputik. Harsh conditions drove most of its people away, many of whom went on to found the Odeila Kingdom. In later years, Frostwaste became known for its cheese production, opening trade with other states on Kuputik. Though small, Frostwaste stood as the final bastion against Frostmorrow's unification before eventually falling.

name: Gahaldur
declaringWar: You have revealed your purposes a bit too early, my friend...
attacked: Traitorous man! I will not stand for such wanton abuse and slander - I shall have your head!
defeated: How could we fall to the likes of you?!

civilopediaText.text: Gahaldur, also known as hill dwarves, are a distinct subgroup of the Gaarili Dwarves who inhabit the hilly regions near the Naru Mountain. They are known to be more open to outsiders and often craft weapons for Sulvana and Anšarim warriors.

name: Shaquad
declaringWar: You have revealed your purposes a bit too early, my friend...
attacked: Traitorous man! I will not stand for such wanton abuse and slander - I shall have your head!
defeated: I guess you weren't here for the sprouts after all...

civilopediaText.text: The city of Shaquad is located on the coast of the Vedic Sea. Founded by colonists from Dayne, the city soon grew to rival and eventually surpass its sister city as a fishing and mercantile center.

name: Vistana
declaringWar: You have revealed your purposes a bit too early, my friend...
attacked: Oh? You must have not heard of our ways of dealing with people like you.
defeated: I will remember you. I will remember your children. I will remember your whole descendants for this humiliation!

civilopediaText.text: Vistana was an ancient city located on the Sumbawa Plains, serving as a vital crossroad and economic hub for decades. It was ultimately destroyed by Gloria after he declared Nursia the new center of commerce under First Order control.

name: Aerithalas
declaringWar: War lingers in our hearts. Why carry on with a false peace?
attacked: You gormless radger! You'll dine on your own teeth before you set foot in Aerithalas!
defeated: A lonely wind blows through the highlands today. A dirge for Aerithalas. Can you hear it?

civilopediaText.text: Living atop the Aerithalas Mountain, the Aeripii are inherently hostile to outsiders, but they can be persuaded to offer their services in exchange for shiny trinkets.

name: Corelia
declaringWar: Let's have a nice little War, shall we?
attacked: Damn you, I will not fall.
defeated: This ship may sink, but our spirits will linger.

name: Dreckfang
declaringWar: Witness my power, insignificant ruler!  Your armies shall crumble before my might!
attacked: how laughable! The world will bear witness to the consequences of your reckless aggression!
defeated: So this is how it feels to die...

civilopediaText.text: Dreckfang were a warband of gnolls led by Ustar Dreckfang who fought for control of the Sava Desert. They later settled around the Two Oases, naming their city after their leader.

name: Naluvir
declaringWar: We have wanted this for a LONG time. War it shall be.
attacked: So you have chosen death.
defeated: Congratulations, conqueror. This tribe serves you now.

name: Grokzut
declaringWar: Itz time! Itz time to WAAAGH diz pathetic weaklingz!
attacked: HAHAHAHA! Diz iz juzt hilarious! Get em, boiz!
defeated: Gahh... I hate when diz happenz...

civilopediaText.text: Grokzut was a tribal state of lizardfolk living along the fertile banks of the Canadian River before being conquered and enslaved by Thallin.

name: Tuskarok
declaringWar: I will enjoy hearing your last breath as you witness the destruction of your realm!
attacked: Very well, we will kick you back to the Dark Age!
defeated: What treachery has struck us? No, what evil?
uniques: [+2 Food] from every [Snow]

civilopediaText.text: The Tuskari are a humanoid walrus-like people indigenous to the Grosvenor Fjord and Stor Isles. Living in coastal settlements carved between glaciers and rocky islands, their generations of tradition have shaped them into resilience warriors, hardy navigators and guardians of the northern waters.

name: Rackedt
declaringWar: We don't like your face. To arms!
attacked: So this is it. You've lost your senses!
defeated: Vile ruler, know that you 'won' this war in name only!

civilopediaText.text: Rackedt is a beastfolk tribal state renowned for the Way of Rackadine, a unique tradition that teaches its people to communicate, train, and form bonds with non-sapient beasts and monsters.

name: Chorislavia
declaringWar: By god's grace we will not allow these atrocities to occur any longer. We declare war!
attacked: I will fear no evil. For God is with me!
defeated: May God grant me these last wishes - peace and prosperity for Chorislavia.

civilopediaText.text: The Chorislaviani were a sub-group of the Thalasia Elves who chose to settle in Buantan. According to the Asili Inscription, Chorislavia was established as the successor to the Verdalia Kingdom, which was destroyed by the Red Elves.

name: E'sholl
declaringWar: By the grace of God, we declare war!
attacked: You shall not trample our temple!
defeated: God is forgiving, will you forgive us?

civilopediaText.text: A theocratic state situated on the Baki Peninsula, E'sholl ultimately fell during the Crusades launched by Sanctum Regalia.

name: Estuary
declaringWar: Do you really think you can walk over us so easily? I will not let it happen. Not to my people!
attacked: May God have mercy on your evil soul.
defeated: Your evil nature are too strong for us to handle.

civilopediaText.text: Estuary is a druidic civilization dwelling in the eastern reaches of the Pringapus Jungle, near the Buantan Sea. It is said that the druids sometimes reveal themselves to aid wandering travelers—provided their hearts bear no ill intent.

name: Nevdes
declaringWar: Everyday you stray further from God. Let me show you the right path!
attacked: You think God will permit your abominations?
defeated: Ah, Gods! Why have you forsaken us?

civilopediaText.text: Nevdes is a religious state on the Central Plains, encircled by powerful neighbors-Thorin Empire to the north and west, and the Berenger Kingdom to the east. It was one of the founding members of the Aeyris Alliance.

name: Zilla
declaringWar: After thorough deliberation, Zillans finds itself at a crossroads. Prepare yourself, for war is upon us.
attacked: Why do we fight? Because revered Zhexue demands it. Now, witness the power of Zillans!
defeated: I for one welcome our new conquer overlord!

civilopediaText.text: A human civilization located on the island of Zilla. The Zillans are credited as the originators of the philosophies of Yin and Yang and the Five Elements.

name: Barbarians
uniques: Can only heal by pillaging
